specification.title: Builder Parameter Range Validation
specification.owner_rule: This L3 exclusively owns the described capability within its parent L2; any other menu/panel calls it through the parent service contract.
specification.parent_scope: Millimeter, degrees, tolerances, numeric input và tham số builder đơn giản.
specification.parent_exclusions: Không cần solver phác thảo cơ khí hay formula dependency phức tạp.

api_contract.input: Typed command/document/geometry data and any selection or builder parameters required by this feature.
api_contract.output: Validated operation result and observable document changes; never silently claim success.
api_contract.edge_cases: Invalid/empty geometry, cancellation and tolerance/pathological input must be handled explicitly.
api_contract.integration: Register one capability owner; adapters dispatch to owning kernel/domain service.

acceptance_tests_auto: Automated: valid input exercises “Builder Parameter Range Validation” without panic, leaked handle or stale scene reference.
Automated: invalid, empty, or degenerate input yields an explicit error and leaves document state consistent.
Automated: each operation changes only its documented state and supports undo/cancel where applicable.
invariants: No `90-after` dependency for any M01–M09 deliverable.
No implementation may be assumed from QymCAD until source paths are checked.
Existing document IDs/layer flags/units/history remain consistent after operation.
No separate OCCT operation should be coded inside a Matrix toolbar/menu adapter.

execution_design.title: Builder Parameter Range Validation
execution_design.positive_oracle_proposed: Validate parameter min=1 max=10 step=0.5 gia tri 5.5 duoc chap nhan
execution_design.negative_oracle_proposed: Gia tri 0,11,NaN va step=0 bi tu choi, state khong doi
execution_design.reuse_approval_condition: Audit local checkout at pinned SHA, compile/tests, M00 human legal approval; do not infer ready from static GitHub read.
execution_design.implementation_owner_policy: One owning L2, UI modules dispatch only. No source code changes in vendor-research/ unless approved fork.
objectives: Define typed seam + explicitly testable oracle
Implement one capability at its canonical owner
Verify failure rollback, stable IDs/units/geometry as relevant

plugin_sdk_v1_parameters.target: standalone Rust OM9, Windows x64 host with an out-of-checkout .om9p plugin
plugin_sdk_v1_parameters.scope: Builder parameter range validation: bounds are canonical and the minimum is exclusive unless min_inclusive; max is inclusive; the optional step grid is measured from min (or zero); a count must be a non-negative integer; choice/text domains and the schema's required/default rules are enforced by request::OptionDomain::check and command_schema::CommandSchema::apply.
limitations: Partial scope only: this entry does not close the L3.
The application has no builder parameter editor yet; UI parity is not claimed.
Document tolerance editing and CPlane frame resolution remain open.

sdk_export_plan.rule: Chỉ bề mặt plugin cần (dữ liệu/sự kiện/hành động) mới vào SDK v1; kernel hình học, UI và adapter host nội bộ không vào SDK.
